description: Take a Scrivener-native snapshot of a document's current content, restorable from Scrivener's own Snapshots browser. Use this before rewriting a document to give the writer a native rollback point. Copies the live content into the project's Snapshots directory with a title and timestamp; does not modify the document. Requires an open project and a document that has content.

documentId.description: UUID of the document to snapshot.

title.description: Snapshot title shown in Scrivener. Defaults to "Snapshot".

name: create_snapshot

snapshotId.description: Id of the new snapshot (for read_snapshot).

title: Create Document Snapshot
